result.question: Quais são os 5 municípios com maior percentual de internações em UTI (com mais de 5000 internações)?
result.gold_sql: SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ORDER BY pct_uti DESC LIMIT 5;
result.generated_sql: WITH total_internacoes AS ( SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ), uti_internacoes AS ( SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 5000 ) SELECT ti."municipio", ROUND(COALESCE(ui.total_uti, 0) * 100.0 / ti.total, 2) AS proporcao FROM total_internacoes ti LEFT JOIN uti_internacoes ui ON ti."municipio" = ui."municipio" ORDER BY proporcao DESC LIMIT 5;
